characterLicense: CC0-1.0; https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ ; MPFB core assets are CC0, distinct from its GPL program code. No MPFB program code is included in the game.
adaptation: Custom clothed child derived from MPFB assets, 53-bone skinning, two mesh detail levels, authored swept hair, eyes, canvas backpack and fabric/skin textures. Original procedural skeletal locomotion and arm IK; no third-party protagonist animation clips or family photos/videos included. Enemy LOD1/LOD2, three original enemy clips, local 2048/1024 textures and runtime budgets retained.
